premise: Neon City's mega-corp OmniClean rolled out MOP robots to 'sanitize' the streets. They're sweeping up every stray, and Bandit's raccoon crew got hauled off toward the MOP-9000's trash plant. Bandit steals back through each district to free the crew and shut the shine down.

introPanels.caption: Neon Docks after-hours: the crew was living large.
introPanels.artHint: raccoon crew partying in alley neon

introPanels.caption: Then OmniClean's MOPs crashed the party.
One by one, the crew got bagged for 'sanitation.'
Mask on. Time to clean up.

neon_docks.title: Neon Docks
neon_docks.flavor: Where the trash tide meets the neon — and OmniClean wants both spotless.

arcade_row.title: Arcade Row
arcade_row.flavor: High scores, higher stakes. The lights never blink — the MOPs do.

rooftops.title: Rooftops
rooftops.flavor: Jump the skyline. Don't look down. Definitely don't look at the scrubbers.

sewer_grid.title: Sewer Grid
sewer_grid.flavor: OmniClean's dirty secret: the shine starts underground.

crew.name: Scrapz
crew.line: If it's bolted down, it's a suggestion.

crew.name: Glitch
crew.line: I speak fluent static — and terrible advice.

crew.name: Fizz
crew.line: Shake me and I explode... with enthusiasm.

paTaunts: OmniClean PA: Spotless is progress. Vermin is... unfinished business.
OmniClean PA: Reminder — raccoons are not a recognized municipal asset.
OmniClean PA: Your shine rating just dropped. How unfortunate.
OmniClean PA: The MOP-9000 sends its regards. And a dustpan.
OmniClean PA: Resistance detected. Applying industrial-strength pep talk.
